assertions.name: connected_magnitude_is_charge_symmetry_invariant
assertions.source: ⁴He connected |b_Ac| broken 1.1739 → charge-symm 1.1840 (Δ=+0.86%, <2%) ⇒ the connected magnitude is decoupled from charge symmetry; #3548's ~74% magnitude gap persists under the charge-symmetric kernel.

description: Re-runs #3548's connected-magnitude probe (irreducible Ursell/Mayer A-body cluster b_A^c, SU(4) C(4,A) gate) on the CHARGE-SYMMETRIC kernel (f_pp=f_nn=f_pn isoscalar) vs the charge-breaking #2089 kernel. FINDING: |b_Ac| is charge-symmetry-invariant (⁴He 1.961→1.972, +0.5%), so #3548's PARTIAL magnitude (⁴He ~×1.5 vs ×2.09 needed) is robust — charge symmetry does NOT close the magnitude gap. ⇒ the two binding levers are decoupled: charge structure (mirror split, fixed by #3575) vs connected magnitude (#3548, still open). Scope-(a), reuses #3548 machinery, no fit, no wiring.
